story.summary: The City of Dallas is investigating whether statistics showing a drop in violent crime may be inaccurate. Dallas is running an audit on potential errors in crime reporting. FOX 4's Lori Brown has more. DALLAS - The City of Dallas is investigating whether statistics showing a drop in violent crime may be inaccurate. On Tuesday, Dallas City Auditor Rory Galter confirmed the city is investigating if crime statistics in the city may be inaccurate. "We are aware of possible incorrect reporting of crimes. This was identified in our entrance conference with the Dallas Police Department," the email read. Galter explained to city leaders on Tuesday that it's currently unknown how widespread the potential inaccuracies are, but that the city may want to look at the possibility.
